Hyperscaler customer concentration and AI-capex cyclicality
SBC-heavy pay and rising diluted share count keep OE/share far below adjusted EPS
moat_for: Design-win / requalification stickiness in defense, telecom and data-center sockets
Deep RF/microwave/mmWave and InP photonics process know-how, broad catalog, 6,000+ customers
Premium positioning — adjusted gross margin guided to 60-61%

moat_justification: Moderate/narrow: design-win and requalification stickiness in RF/photonics sockets, decades of compound-semiconductor process know-how, a broad catalog serving 6,000+ customers, and premium adjusted gross margins guided to 60-61% — but no network effects or owned platform, much larger rivals in every socket, technology transitions (silicon photonics, co-packaged optics, CW lasers) that must be re-won each generation, hyperscaler concentration, and SBC-heavy pay with a rising share count keeping GAAP owner's earnings far below adjusted earnings.
name: MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc.
one_liner: Real AI-optical growth story, moat 5/10 — but owner's earnings of $1.55/share TTM cannot support $282.90 (weighted IRR 4.58%, IV@15% $37.07); it clears 15% only at or below ~$37.
